card.name: Brain anatomy: optic and internal before structure
card.fires_on: Anatomical modifier words such as optic, internal, lateral or lower right before a brain structure name (chiasma, capsule, radiations, centers), in old anatomy-textbook passages about the thalamus.

modes.label: Modifier before brain structure
modes.description: An adjective like optic, internal or lateral sits just before a structure noun such as chiasma or capsule.
modes.example: which passes through the posterior part of the<< optic>> chiasma.

modes.label: Start of a tube name
modes.description: The opening piece of a medical word in a procedure sentence, before the rest of the word.
modes.example: allow for the insertion of a<< nas>>ogastric tube.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
